SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1.Special Branch
REPORT
File No.
S.A. RY
No. N 3406/41
Date March 16, 1941.

Subject (in full) Attempted assassination of Chang Yang Nyi (張養義).

Made by D.I. Pan Lien Pih Forwarded by C.D.I. Tabrum

At about 11 a.m. on March 16, 1941, Chang Yang
Nyi (張養義) an employee of the Shanghai Customs
House and concurrently Deputy of the Central Reserve
Bank, 15 The Bund, was shot and wounded in the leg at
his home, No.73 Lane 291 Rte. Herve de Seiyer, F.C.
by a male Chinese who later made good his escape.
Chang was subsequently removed to St. Marie's Hospital,
Rte Pere Robert, F.C. where he is being detained.

（签名）
Dan Lien-pih
D. I.

A.C.(Special Branch)

日期 1941年3月16日。

事由（全称）张养义遇刺未遂案。

由警探潘连璧呈报，经首席警探塔布鲁姆转呈

1941年3月16日上午11时许，上海海关职员兼中央储备银行（外滩15号）副理张养义，在法租界西爱咸斯路291弄73号寓所内，被一名华籍男子开枪击伤腿部，该男子随后逃逸。张氏随后被送往法租界贝当路圣玛丽医院，目前留院治疗。

（签名）
潘连璧
警探

Terrorists
Shoot, Hack
Bank Clerk

Slain In Hospital. One
Month After Wounded
By Gunmen In Leg

Guns of political assassins claim-
ed another victim at 10.10 yester-
day morning when Chung Yang-
feng, employee of the Central Re-
serve Bank, was shot and hacked
to death by seven men in a hos-
pital at 19 Route Pottier where he
was nursing a bullet wound receiv-
ed exactly one month ago in front
of his residence at 219 Route des
Sieyes. The brutal slaying took
place in the presence of the
victim's wife and two children who
were paying Chang a visit.

Seven men strong, the gunmen
entered the hospital, which is a
private institution called Dah Hwa,
and requested to see Chang, saying
that they are his friends. Shown to
the ward they filed one by one into
the room which was occupied by
Chang who was lying in bed with
an amputated leg, his wife and two
children and a body guard.

The armed bodyguard seeing the
men, immediately withdrew leav-
ing his master at the mercy of the
gunmen. While the terrified
mother and children hid behind the
bed filling the air with cries for
help one of the men produced a
pistol and pointing it at Chang
fired. The bullet entered the
victim's skull and caused im-
mediate death.

Producing a hatchet another
member of the gang approached
Chang's prostrate body on the bed
and inflicted a few vicious cuts on
the face. Their blood orgy com-
pleted, the men withdrew taking
the bodyguard along with them.

Officers of the French Police ar-
rived on the scene after the gun-
men made good their escape. At
a late hour last night the Shang-
hai Municipal, French, Western
Area and City Government police
force were conducting a joint man-
hunt for the brutal assassins.

1941年4月17日

恐怖分子
枪击、斧砍
银行职员

受伤一月后
在医院遭枪手枪击腿部
终告不治

昨日（16日）上午10时10分，政治刺客的枪口又夺去了一条生命。中央储备银行职员钟阳峰（音译）在波蒂埃路19号的一家医院内，被七名男子枪击并乱刀砍死。一个月前，他正是在西爱咸斯路219号寓所门前遭枪手击中腿部而入院疗伤。这起残忍的凶杀案发生时，受害人的妻子和两名子女正在探视，目睹了全过程。

这七名枪手进入这家名为“大华”的私立医院，要求见钟氏，声称是他的朋友。被引至病房后，他们逐一进入房间。当时钟氏因腿部截肢正卧床休养，房内还有他的妻子、两名子女以及一名保镖。

持枪保镖见到这些人后，立即撤离，将雇主置于枪手的掌控之下。惊恐万状的母亲和孩子躲在床后，大声呼救。其中一人掏出手枪，对准钟氏开火。子弹击中受害者头骨，致其当场死亡。

另一名匪徒掏出斧头，走近床上倒卧的钟氏尸体，在其面部狠砍数下。完成这场血腥暴行后，这些人撤离现场，并将保镖一并带走。

法国警察局的警官在枪手成功逃逸后抵达现场。昨晚深夜，上海公共租界工部局警务处、法国警察局、西区警局以及市政府警察部队正在进行联合搜捕，缉拿这些残忍的刺客。
